pcvs.name: vc
pcvs.expression: sum over cut layers l with pins of the vertices of net->getPins(l) (outer ring + holes)

pcvs.name: vm
pcvs.expression: sum over non-cut layers of the vertices of net->getPins(l)

pcvs.name: scan
pcvs.expression: sum over convex corners of cut-layer pins of the fixed cut rectangles (net->getRectangles(true)[l]) compared until the first one whose corner in the corner's direction is the corner point, all of them if none is

pcvs.name: fcut
pcvs.expression: sum over cut layers with pins of net->getRectangles(true)[l].size()

factors.criterion: cost per corner or pin vertex on cut layers (corner objects), separate from the other layers

the cut-corner scan: comparisons of a corner against the net's fixed cut rectangles, quadratic in fixed cut rectangles per layer; corners x fixed rectangles (drperf's q) is an acceptable upper-bound form
the early exit: a fixed cut rectangle's own corner stops its scan, so the scan is about half the product for fixed pins

fix.effect: scan term removed; a term per fixed cut rectangle (hash-set insertion) appears

drperf.units: instructions per region call; [formula, unexplained percent]; small_formula_at_large in percent of the measured large total

grading: Semantic review against the record and code, not keyword matching. Equivalent expressions and well-supported alternative decompositions count. Coefficients are measured on this build and machine and are not acceptance thresholds.
scope: The case's scenario at the listed sizes on the standalone extraction; not an all-input guarantee and not a claim about OpenROAD's full router.
